pages.text: The $(item)Advanced Geothermal Generator$() is an MV throughput upgrade to the $(l:ftbic:generators/geothermal)Geothermal Generator$(). Its default output is $(thing)60⚡/t$().
It uses lava and has a 24,000 mB internal tank on the 1.19.2 implementation. At default balance it consumes lava about three times faster than the normal Geothermal Generator.
Lava consumption scales against FTBIC's configured Geothermal Generator output, preserving the intended energy-per-mB relationship when a pack changes upstream generator balance.
The generator can charge compatible FTBIC energy items. Jade can show stored energy and lava level, and normal recipe viewers can show its crafting recipe.
